description: This file defines the 'Details' feature for profiles in a C# ASP.NET Core project, including a request query, validator, and request handler for retrieving profile details.

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validates that the Username property in the query is not empty.

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the profile detail request by reading the profile via the profileReader service.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the Query to retrieve a ProfileEnvelope asynchronously.
